title: Decision Protocols & Conditional Logic
description: Agent, teach Chronos to think. Use if, elif, and else to create programs that react intelligently to different situations. Your code will make decisions like a human operative.

exercises.title: Clearance Check: Indentation Purpose
exercises.description: CHRONOS SYNTAX PROTOCOL: What is the purpose of indentation in Python?
options: It defines a block of code (scope)
It makes the code run faster

exercises.title: Clearance Check: Else Block Execution
exercises.description: CHRONOS LOGIC GATE: When does the code inside an else block execute?
options: When the if condition is True
When the if condition is False

exercises.title: Neural Sync: Critical Power Threshold Alert
exercises.description: CHRONOS POWER MONITORING: Reactor core approaching critical threshold! If power_level exceeds 9000 units, the system must trigger an immediate warning to prevent catastrophic overload. Implement the conditional check to monitor power levels and alert engineering teams when the threshold is breached.
exercises.targetCode: if power_level > 9000:\n    print("Warning: Power level critical! Over 9000!")

exercises.title: Neural Sync: Lockdown Protocol Activation
exercises.description: CHRONOS ACCESS CONTROL: Unauthorized access attempt detected! When security verification fails, the system must engage the else block to deny entry and initiate lockdown procedures. Add the fallback security protocol message to protect classified areas from intrusion.
exercises.targetCode: else:\n    print("Access Denied. Security protocol engaged. Lockdown initiated.")

exercises.title: Neural Sync: Administrative Privilege Check
exercises.description: CHRONOS ROLE MANAGEMENT: Multi-tier access control system requires elif logic for different clearance levels. Check if user_role equals 'admin' to grant full system access with administrative privileges. This intermediate check sits between standard user and denied access conditions.
exercises.targetCode: elif user_role == "admin":\n    print("Welcome, Administrator. Full access granted.")

exercises.title: System Repair: Indentation Failure
exercises.description: CRITICAL ERROR: Print statement not executing! It's not indented, so it's not part of the if block. Fix the indentation!

exercises.title: System Repair: Missing Colon
exercises.description: SYNTAX ERROR: If statement failing! Missing colon at end of condition line. This is REQUIRED in Python!

exercises.title: Field Mission: Secure Facility Gate
exercises.description: CHRONOS PERIMETER SECURITY: Deploy automated gate control system for classified facility. Input access code from operative. If code matches 'open', grant entry with 'Welcome' message. Otherwise, engage security lockdown with 'Locked' alert.

exercises.title: Field Mission: Autonomous Traffic Director
exercises.description: CHRONOS URBAN CONTROL: Deploy AI traffic management system for city-wide vehicle coordination. Input signal color from intersection sensors. Red light = 'Stop' command, Green light = 'Go' command, any other color = 'Caution' protocol. Use elif for multi-path logic!

exercises.title: Field Mission: Data Stream Analyzer
exercises.description: CHRONOS DATA INTELLIGENCE: Analyze incoming data packets for threat assessment. Input integer value from sensor network. Classify as 'Pos' if positive (threat detected), 'Neg' if negative (safe zone), or 'Zero' if neutral (monitoring required).

exercises.title: Neural Sync: Tactical Threat Assessment
exercises.description: CHRONOS SECURITY OPERATIONS: Implement 3-tier threat level classification system. Threat level 1 indicates LOW risk (routine patrol), level 2 indicates MEDIUM risk (enhanced surveillance), all other levels indicate HIGH risk (tactical response required). Use if/elif/else chain to categorize and alert appropriate response teams.

exercises.title: Neural Sync: Multi-Level Security Clearance
exercises.description: CHRONOS CLASSIFIED ACCESS: Implement 4-tier security clearance verification system. Level 1: RESTRICTED (public access only), Level 2: CONFIDENTIAL (agents only), Level 3: SECRET (field operatives), Level 4+: TOP SECRET (director level). Input clearance level and display appropriate access permissions with professional formatting for security logs.

exercises.title: Debug Challenge: Elif Syntax Error
exercises.description: URGENT: Security checkpoint crash! Missing colon after elif condition. Fix before system lockdown!
exercises.brokenCode:
score = 85
if score >= 90:
    print('A')
elif score >= 80
    print('B')
else:
    print('C')
exercises.starterCode:
score = 85
if score >= 90:
    print('A')
elif score >= 80
    print('B')
else:
    print('C')

exercises.title: Access Control: Rank Permissions
exercises.description: CHRONOS HIERARCHY: Input rank (1-4). Print: 1='Field Agent', 2='Senior Agent', 3='Team Lead', 4='Director'. Use elif!

exercises.title: Mission Priority: Urgency Classifier
exercises.description: CHRONOS OPERATIONS: Input urgency (1-5). 5='CRITICAL', 4='HIGH', 3='MEDIUM', 2='LOW', 1='ROUTINE'. Print level.

exercises.title: Enemy Intel: Threat Assessment
exercises.description: CHRONOS TACTICAL: Input enemy count. <10='Minimal', 10-50='Moderate', 51-100='Severe', >100='Critical'. Use ranges!

exercises.title: Boss Challenge: Performance Evaluation
exercises.description: CHRONOS CLASSIFIED: Rate operative. Input score (0-100). 90+='Elite', 75-89='Excellent', 60-74='Competent', 50-59='Acceptable', <50='Reassignment Required'.
